notes.title: Zero-Sum Heart Now Available in Spanish (LATAM)
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]This is Jenny and Mari, developers of Zero-Sum Heart. We wanted to pop in for an exciting announcement: Zero-Sum Heart is now available in LATAM Spanish![/p][p][/p][p]We want to say our heartfelt thanks to the generous help of Francisca Stachiotti, who worked on the translation and localization QA with incredible dedication! And we hope you the players will enjoy it :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/42def155abf26380d5958032b4221919eb974f57.png"][/img][/p][p]Other game updates in 1.0.16:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "two years later" and "ten years later" screens weren't displaying correctly in certain languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the strikethrough texts in bubble dialogue weren't displayed correctly in certain languages.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are also currently participating in Fall In Love festival, full of romance visual novels from other wonderful developers around the world! Please check out the other works in the festival, and we hope you enjoy playing :)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/0983883c2f9c8a5949053b22a3343f98c01654c0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Zero-Sum Heart - French Support Added
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We are so excited to tell you that Zero-Sum Heart is now available in French![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/bc73cb7995dcedad62486516032a1e2550fdb57d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We want to give our sincere gratitude to [b]ZHY club[/b], particularly these following translators, for their hard work in bringing Zero-Sum Heart to life in French:[/p][list][*][p]djin[/p][/*][*][p]Ouragan[/p][/*][*][p]fhkatez[/p][/*][*][p]Dur-714[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are in love with how these graphics look, and we are excited to bring it to a new audience:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/8c9df1192a70897b4f8b9b7262eeb3e81a590f53.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additional patch note for 1.0.13:[/p][list][*][p]Added a credits video in French with translated lyric subtitles and translation credits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in Japanese and Traditional Chinese where the gallery title and background were displayed incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p](Spoilers) Fixed a bug in which the game failed to account for whether players had jumped in the lake to retrieve the bracelet when it... uh, comes up later in a certain conversation with the witch. Damn you Steam, give me back my spoiler tags in the visual editor please![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are also going to work with our Nintendo Switch platform publishers to bring this update to our NS version as soon as possible, but that may take a little more time with working with porting and platform certification wait (Btw if you didn't know, Zero-Sum Heart is now on Nintendo Switch, featuring a deluxe version with the artbook and OST yay!)[/p]

notes.title: Zero-Sum Heart is OUT NOW on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]This is Mari & Jenny from Citreat Studio.[/p][p][/p][p]We are so excited to announce that Zero-Sum Heart is now out on Nintendo Switch! This edition includes the digital artbook and OST too :) You can purchase and play it right now for 10% off across all regions! [/p][p][/p][p]This was a small and personal project for us, and we never imagined we could bring it to another platform and a new audience, so thank our NS publisher/porting partner Cyberisle for making it happen. [/p][p][/p][p]Hope you all enjoy it! [/p][p]Best, Mari & Jenny[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/c15793a0687c461f24b77be4d26679122a2f8216.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Zero-Sum Heart is coming to Nintendo Switch on July 24th!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]This is Mari and Jenny from Citreat Studio! We are excited to work with Jump to bring you Zero-Sum Heart on Nintendo Switch eShop on July 24th :) [/p][p][/p][p]The Switch version will contain the game itself, the Original Soundtrack, and the Artbook with our commentaries. You can pre-order it now on eShop for 10% off <3[/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to bring our little game to a whole new platform and new audiences! Thank you for your support, and we hope you have a nice day :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/a32af7b713fac800a2df5db989414802ab5d16ba.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Japanese Localization Added!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to announce that with the great help of a player 望入世, we've now added Japanese localization for the whole game! We are very excited to see more players be able to enjoy the game with this new update :)

Other Fixes:
[list]
[*] Updated the Settings menu (Made font consistent across settings text, took off font and voice volume)
[*] Reduced the file size of the credits cutscene & therefore reducing build size
[*] Fixed an issue with Traditional Chinese Localization where choosing to talk to Mushroom about your feelings will lead to text incorrectly displayed in English
[*] Fixed an issue with Traditional Chinese version where the [2 years later] and [10 years later] time skip countdown UI wouldn't display correctly
[/list]

We also want to share with you a couple of comic drabbles we drew as a crossover between Zero-Sum Heart and our previous game Death Trick: Double Blind:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/a4c52f295acc3ba51acd50ed84a634f06b62707a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040836/fb473c3e103860ee781ec86cfde5f651c6091cb0.png[/img]

You can find these games together in this little bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46209/From_the_same_creators/

notes.title: 1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug fix:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where I built the previous version when my Unity license disconnected, causing the "trial version" watermark appearing at the bottom right of the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the log page shows the protagonist's name as "IChildhood" during a flashback.
[*] Fixed a typo in Chinese localization.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for playing Zero-Sum Heart! Here's a quick patch-- If you encounter any more bugs, you can reply to the bug report thread in the forum, or message us through Discord.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players get stuck on certain mid-game ending pages
[*] Fixed a bug where in the [spoiler]Water Under the Bridge[/spoiler] ending, the protagonist sprites have a display error: [spoiler]Her hair should be white, not blue.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a bug where during [spoiler]Ritual reversal[/spoiler], The Witch [spoiler]mistakenly tells you you've killer Bear, even if you hadn't[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed a few typos and rogue punctuation marks.
[/list]

notes.title: Zero-Sum Heart is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This is Mari & Jenny, the developers of Zero-Sum Heart.

We are so excited, and anxious, and grateful, and relieved to tell you: Zero-Sum Heart is out now!

We've been hard at work pouring our hearts (hehe, get it, hearts?) into this game for the past six months, and we hope something in the story resonates with you too.

Zero-Sum Heart will be 10% off for the next two weeks, grab it to give it a try:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954920/ZeroSum_Heart/


We also have a Deluxe bundle, complete with a 14-track original soundtrack and 80-page artbook with developer commentary, which you can get here:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45305/ZeroSum_Heart_Deluxe/


If you are looking for more character-centric, emotionally nuanced storytelling games, or if you played Zero-Sum Heart and think you enjoyed the writing/art/music, you can also check out this bundle, which includes Death Trick: Double Blind, made by the same development crew, for an additional 20% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46209/From_the_same_creators/

notes.title: Try the demo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We are so excited to tell you we've basically wrapped production on Zero-Sum Heart! Doing some final bug fixing now, and we are working on finalizing the artbook and soundtrack to be released with the full game. 

Looking forward to sharing this story with everyone on November 1st, as a late Halloween gift :)

For now, welcome to Steam Next fest! You can still try our demo, and don't worry, your save files should be able to carry over to the full game :)

Please click here to add Zero-Sum Heart to your wishlist to receive email notification when it launches:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954920/ZeroSum_Heart/
